title: Helios rollout readiness review
summary: Raw transcript only. No decisions, actions or risks are pre-filled; the analysis runtime derives them.

transcript.speaker: Dana Whitfield
transcript.text: The enterprise pilot is the fixed point. Everything else moves around it.

transcript.speaker: Ravi Menon
transcript.text: Support can cover the pilot, but not the same week as self-serve onboarding.

transcript.speaker: Dana Whitfield
transcript.text: Then we hold the enterprise pilot on the fourth and move self-serve onboarding to the eighteenth.

transcript.speaker: Elena Sokolova
transcript.text: That gives security two extra weeks for the admin console review.

transcript.speaker: Ravi Menon
transcript.text: I will send the revised support rota by Friday. The eighth and ninth are still thin.

transcript.speaker: Dana Whitfield
transcript.text: Borrow one engineer from platform for that weekend if the rota does not close.

transcript.speaker: Dana Whitfield
transcript.text: The first release ships the read-only admin console. Bulk import waits.

transcript.speaker: Ravi Menon
transcript.text: Two customers will ask about bulk import as soon as the note goes out.

transcript.speaker: Elena Sokolova
transcript.text: I will finish the threat model for the admin console by the eighth.

transcript.speaker: Dana Whitfield
transcript.text: We will run the concierge import manually for those two accounts.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Berlin can run the pilot with two trainers. I will confirm that tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: The field team needs the updated runbook before the fifth.

transcript.speaker: Dana Whitfield
transcript.text: I will publish the updated rollout note and runbook to customers by the fifth.

transcript.speaker: Elena Sokolova
transcript.text: Do we need a second on-call engineer for the pilot weekend?

transcript.speaker: Dana Whitfield
transcript.text: The audit export is not required for the pilot. It can wait for self-serve.
